verdict.rationale: Persona documents Reports as a way to add information about an end user beyond what they submit, and Address Lookup is a listed report type, which touches the address-history part of the story. Device signals are mentioned only in passing, as a benefit of the Mobile SDKs, and no phone, email, or device-fingerprint check types are documented. Missing for 10: documented phone/carrier risk checks, email risk checks, a device fingerprint check type, address-history detail beyond the Address Lookup name, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
